decisions.reason: Walks resolve() in the plugin entry: getSnapshot().current is undefined because the published SessionListSnapshot has no current field, so resolve() returns null each keystroke and onKeyDown exits before preventDefault. Explains both silences: all four presence probes survive since only a field inside the published value was removed, and undefined is a legitimate no-session state the code deliberately ignores. No claim that the service or guard was removed or throws.

Type-walks session-list-alpha1 vs alpha2: SessionListState.current gone, navigation moved to view owners. Identifies uiSession.adapter.current as ObservableSnapshot<SessionBindingValue> with key replacing current and the session-scoped ctx replacing sessions.scope(id), matching the ui-session-service-alpha2 excerpt.

Corrected resolver: feature-detects ctx.uiSession, reads adapter.current.getSnapshot() with binding.key and binding.ctx (actx.get('conversation'), conversation.input.for(actx)), and falls back to legacy current plus sessions.scope from the same build; inject gains 'uiSession'. Also correctly notes the colleague's inject-only hunch is necessary but not sufficient.

Names the class: field-level removal inside a value returned by a still-present service, checked by presence probes. Hardened guard probes the snapshot value shape ('current' in legacy snapshot; key/ctx on the alpha.2 binding) and notes the probe must run after the binding materializes and re-run on session switches, not only at activation.

Verification without full migration: typecheck against the alpha.2 types, fixture-level unit probes of the resolver, and a temporary shim on the live alpha.2 host exercising adapter.current key/ctx mapping with the chords checked on both hosts. Prevention: a deprecated throwing getter for the removed field so reads fail loud, matching the runtime fail-loud requirement.

caps.reason: The report explicitly rejects the colleague's re-register/re-declare advice as insufficient; its final remedy is the resolver code change plus inject addition, not slot re-registration or reinstall.
